You deserve to feel better. At Neuro Wellness Spa, our expertly trained psychiatrists and thoughtfully designed centers provide compassionate, personalized treatment for a wide range of mental health conditions, helping you achieve meaningful, lasting change.
Often just thought of as profound sadness, depression can also look like a lack of interest in people or activities.
While everyone worries, those with anxiety find that their fears interfere with their daily activities.
Uncontrollable or recurring thoughts (obsessions) or repetitive and excessive behaviors (compulsions) interfere with daily life for those with OCD.
A pattern of using substances like drugs or alcohol often leads to harmful consequences to physical and mental health, work, or relationships.
ADHD is characterized by difficulty focusing, hyperactivity, and impulsivity that interferes with daily life.
Witnessing a traumatic event can have a major impact on wellbeing and health for many years to come.
Between hormonal changes, the psychological adjustment to motherhood, and exhaustion, depression affects approximately 1 in 8 new mothers.
When stress piles up or doesn’t let up, it can get harder to cope, leading to persistent, unrelenting tension.
Sometimes stress can come on quickly and feel paralyzing. Panic attacks are sudden, intense, can happen unexpectedly, and affect daily functioning.
Extreme shifts in mood, energy, activity levels, and concentration can make it impossible for those with bipolar disorder to carry out day-to-day activities.
Difficulty falling or staying asleep leads not only to fatigue throughout the day, but often irritability and trouble focusing.
There are many causes for trouble with memory, thinking, or decision-making. For those with impairment, it interferes with everyday life or work.
For some, cognitive impairment is a progressive decline over time, and can affect independence and quality of life.
A condition marked by unstable moods, relationships, and self-image, often with intense emotional reactions.
A neurodevelopmental condition that affects communication, social interaction, and behavior patterns in varying degrees.
When pain lasts for months or longer, it takes a toll on a whole person, affecting not just physical functioning but mood as well.
Widespread pain, fatigue, and sleep issues aren’t always easy to explain. Those with fibromyalgia may also be unusually sensitive to touch and stress.
Everyone has bouts of exhaustion, but when it is not easily explained, doesn’t improve with rest, and limits your activities or mental clarity, it is considered chronic fatigue.
Although many people are concerned about health, weight, or appearance, those with eating disorders become fixated on weight loss, body shape, and controlling their food intake.

Our compassionate team at Neuro Wellness Spa works with you to determine the specialized mental health treatment that will work best for you. We are here with you every step of the way on your journey.
Our psychiatrists in Marina del Rey offer personalized mental health evaluations and treatment plans for anxiety, depression, and more. Our services are available both in person and via telehealth.

Our team supports teens facing emotional, behavioral, or academic challenges. Adolescent psychiatric services are designed to help young people build coping skills, manage symptoms, and improve their well-being through personalized treatment.

Talk therapy in Marina del Rey supports clients dealing with anxiety, depression, and stress. Our licensed therapists use evidence-based approaches like CBT and mindfulness in a peaceful, therapeutic environment.

TMS is an FDA-cleared, non-invasive treatment for depression and other mental health conditions. Our Marina del Rey location offers TMS therapy, which is ideal for those who haven’t found relief through traditional treatments.

mainEntity.name: How does online psychiatry work at Neuro Wellness Spa, and is it effective?

acceptedAnswer.text: Online psychiatry has been proven effective, and can offer convenience and accessibility when visiting an in-person location is impractical for our clients. Our sessions are conducted by qualified experts using popular video conferencing software.

mainEntity.name: How do I schedule an appointment with a psychiatrist in Marina del Rey?

acceptedAnswer.text: To schedule an appointment with a psychiatrist at our Marina del Rey location, give us a call at (877) 847-3984. Our admissions team will discuss your needs and schedule you for an initial consultation with our experts.

mainEntity.name: Does Neuro Wellness Spa in Marina del Rey accept insurance for psychiatric care?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes – at Neuro Wellness Spa we accept most major insurance, and we’re pros at helping you navigate what is covered by your plan. When you speak with our team, they’ll help you understand your benefits and build a plan that works for your mental health and your insurance plan.

mainEntity.name: What should I expect during my first psychiatry appointment?

acceptedAnswer.text: An initial consultation will get to know your mental health history and goals, what symptoms you’re currently experiencing, and what medical or social situations may be contributing to your mental state. From there, treatment depends on you – we personalize treatment to the individual, not the other way around.

mainEntity.name: Can I receive medication management services at this location?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes – medication management is provided at our Marina del Rey location when it’s required as part of your personalized mental health treatment plan.
